meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 看懂工具里的每条提示,弄清它到底能做什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果看到工具里的提示却不知道它具体指什么。
copy.tagline_en: Understand what each in-tool tip actually does before you rely on it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spot a tip while using the tool and want to know what it really does.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 不再凭记忆回答:它会先查到当前实际存在的 tip 列表和你的设置,再读对应代码,然后用你提问的语言解释那条 tip 的真实机制,并给出所读文件的路径。
howto.when: 当你问到某条 tip、某个 tip 提到的功能是做什么的,或想看你目前能看到哪些 tip 时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 会用你提问的语言解释,并附上所读文件路径。

say.text: 我现在实际能看到哪些 tip?
say.note: 会先跑 --list-tips 并读你的设置再回答。

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后那条 tip 背后做了什么?
say.note: 会逐步讲 fallback-architect 的流程。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude stops answering from memory: it fetches the live tip list and your settings, reads the matching code, then explains that tip's real mechanism in your language, citing the file paths it read.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can currently see.

say_en.text: What was that Tip: line I just saw?
say_en.note: Explained in the language you asked in, with file paths.

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see right now?
say_en.note: Runs --list-tips and reads your settings first.

say_en.text: What's behind the tip after a Fable 5 refusal?
say_en.note: Walks the fallback-architect pipeline step by step.
